stemMd: Which line is perpendicular to $y=-\frac12 x+4$?
explanationMd: For nonvertical perpendicular lines, the slope product is −1. Multiplying −1/2 by 2 gives −1, so slope two is required.

distractorRationale.a: The reciprocal also requires the opposite sign.
distractorRationale.b: This has the same slope and is parallel.
distractorRationale.e: The slope product would not be negative one.
distractorRationale.d: The product of slopes would be positive one.
